claims.text: Everard was the youngest son of Adelard Took. At Bilbo's Farewell Party in , he danced the Springle-ring with Melilot Brandybuck when he thought the Speech was over.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Took of Great Smials"; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Fellowship of the Ring, "A Long-expected Party"

claims.text:
Everard's name was originally 'Prospero' until Tolkien's sixth draft version of A Long-expected Party.
